alt: Two spanning trees of the same six-city graph, one chosen by taking edges in the order they were listed and one by taking them cheapest first. Both connect every city without a cycle, but the first costs 35 and the second costs 23.

steps.caption: Both trees use the same cycle check and connect all 6 cities. Taking the edges in the order they were listed costs 35. Taking them cheapest first costs 23, the minimum: sorting is what makes the greedy choice optimal.
